effect.$description: Style knobs that components read. The defaults give the standard look; a style (data-style) changes them.

depth-control.$description: Height of the hard edge under a button. 0 for the standard look. A pressed button moves down by motion.distance.press, so the edge disappears when it is pushed in.

sheen-strength.$description: Strength of the soft shading at the bottom of solid buttons. 0 gives a flat fill. The rim light comes from shadow.sheen.

glow-strength.$description: Opacity of the colored glow under solid buttons, checkboxes and switches. 0 turns it off.

tone-fill.$description: 0 tints only the media area of a toned card; 1 fills the whole card with the tone.
